ns2:course.label: Worldwide Spoken French
ns2:course.description: Advanced undergraduate seminar focusing on speaking and understanding French as a culturally and linguistically diverse language around the world. Prerequisite: FR 205 and FR 212 or equivalents, or authorization of the instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FR 205 and FR 212 or equivalents, or authorization of the instructor.
